# Ravindrakumar M. Purohit

> Ph.D. Candidate in Speech & Audio Signal Processing at Dhirubhai Ambani University (DAU, formerly DA-IICT), Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India.

## Research Interests
Speech & Audio Signal Processing, Deep Learning Speech Synthesis (Text-to-Speech / Vocoders), Voice Conversion, Speaker Diarization, and Audio Deepfake Detection for low-resource and Indic languages.

## Selected Publications
- **BAANI Punjabi Vocoder** (ICPR 2026): A 296M-parameter neural vocoder for Punjabi speech synthesis.
- **Swar Vocoder** (IJCNN 2025): Longformer and Speaker-Aware GAN Vocoders for low-resource Indic speech synthesis.
- **Vaachika** (EUSIPCO 2025): GAN-based neural vocoder tailored for Marathi TTS.

## Projects
- **FC-HiFiGAN & PPHiFi-TTS**: Fast-converging audio synthesis models with phonetic preservation.
- **Multi-lingual Audio Deepfake corpora (MLADDC & GGMDDC)**: Evaluation frameworks for deepfake detection.
